id: \bHave you ever thought about crossing through the trees? Where would you end up?
en: \bHave you ever thought about crossing through the trees? Where would you end up?
it: \bHai mai pensato di passare attraverso gli alberi? Dove finiresti?

id: \bGoh: I found the fossils. Cara Liss was able to revive some of them. I'm guessing you'd like to see them.
en: \bGoh: I found the fossils. Cara Liss was able to revive some of them. I'm guessing you'd like to see them.
it: \bGoh: Ho trovato i fossili. Cara Liss è riuscita a rianimarne alcuni. Immagino che vorrai vederli.

id: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Johan, located in Iki Town, is ready for battle.
en: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Johan, located in Iki Town, is ready for battle.
it: Smart Rotom: Annuncio. Nuovo avversario trovato per le World Coronation Series. Johan, a Lili, è pronto a lottare.

id: \bGoh: I think that's everything here. I'm going back to the lab.
en: \bGoh: I think that's everything here. I'm going back to the lab.
it: \bGoh: Credo che qui abbiamo finito. Torno al laboratorio.

id: \bStrong Pokémon wait across from here. I've only been over there once.
en: \bStrong Pokémon wait across from here. I've only been over there once.
it: \bDall'altra parte ci sono Pokémon forti che aspettano. Ci sono stato una volta sola.

id: \rI came looking for a battle, but most Trainers here are busy catching Pokémon.
en: \rI came looking for a battle, but most Trainers here are busy catching Pokémon.
it: \rSono venuta in cerca di lotte, ma qui gli Allenatori sono quasi tutti impegnati a catturare Pokémon.

id: \bWe're working to find ancient Pokémon that went extinct.
en: \bWe're working to find ancient Pokémon that went extinct.
it: \bStiamo cercando di trovare Pokémon antichi ormai estinti.

id: \bWe recently revived an Arctozolt. Would you like it?
en: \bWe recently revived an Arctozolt. Would you like it?
it: \bDi recente abbiamo rianimato un Arctozolt. Lo vuoi?

id: \bCome back if you change your mind.
en: \bCome back if you change your mind.
it: \bTorna se cambi idea.

id: \bPlease talk to my female colleague if you have fossils of these ancient Pokémon.
en: \bPlease talk to my female colleague if you have fossils of these ancient Pokémon.
it: \bSe hai fossili di questi Pokémon antichi, parla con la mia collega.

id: \rI'm working on finding Galar fossils to bring back to life.
en: \rI'm working on finding Galar fossils to bring back to life.
it: \rSto cercando fossili di Galar da riportare in vita.

id: \rI need some more time though. Come back later.
en: \rI need some more time though. Come back later.
it: \rMi serve però ancora un po' di tempo. Torna più tardi.

id: \rI've discovered a rare fossil Pokémon. I don't need it anymore though. Would you take it for me?
en: \rI've discovered a rare fossil Pokémon. I don't need it anymore though. Would you take it for me?
it: \rHo scoperto un raro Pokémon fossile. Però non mi serve più. Lo prenderesti tu per me?

id: \rVery well.
en: \rVery well.
it: \rD'accordo.

id: \rTalk to my assistant if you want to take any we no longer need.
en: \rTalk to my assistant if you want to take any we no longer need.
it: \rParla con il mio assistente se vuoi prendere quelli che non ci servono più.

id: \rWait, are those some Galar fossils you have for me?
en: \rWait, are those some Galar fossils you have for me?
it: \rAspetta, sono fossili di Galar quelli che hai per me?

id: \rWould you like me to revive them for you?
en: \rWould you like me to revive them for you?
it: \rVuoi che li riporti in vita per te?

id: \rThat's alright. Come back again if you'd like some fossils revived.
en: \rThat's alright. Come back again if you'd like some fossils revived.
it: \rNessun problema. Torna pure se vorrai far rianimare dei fossili.

id: \rNice! Let's see what Pokémon we get from these two fossils...
en: \rNice! Let's see what Pokémon we get from these two fossils...
it: \rOttimo! Vediamo che Pokémon otteniamo da questi due fossili...

id: \rLooks like you've got a \v[9]!

id: \rCome back again if you'd like some fossils revived!

en: \bGoh: \PN! You won't believe it. I caught my first Pokémon.

en: \bI know it's not Mew, but together with Scorbunny I believe we'll be able to catch every Pokémon on my quest to obtain it.
